items.jp: 夕食後テレビのニュースを見た。

translation.pt-BR: Depois do jantar, vi o noticiário na TV.
translation.en: I watched the news on TV after supper.

items.label: ligação entre dois substantivos
items.explanation: の amarra テレビ a ニュース: 'as notícias da TV', ou seja, o noticiário que passa na televisão.

items.jp: 明日の今ごろまでには、私はロンドンにいるでしょう。

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã a esta hora eu já devo estar em Londres.
translation.en: I will be in London by this time tomorrow.

items.label: liga dois substantivos
items.explanation: の prende 明日 a 今ごろ e forma 明日の今ごろ, 'por volta desta hora de amanhã'.

items.jp: 明日の今ごろはロンドン見物をしているでしょう。

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã a esta hora a gente deve estar passeando por Londres.
translation.en: We'll be doing the sights of London about this time tomorrow.

items.label: liga dois substantivos
items.explanation: の une 明日 e 今ごろ para formar 'por volta desta hora de amanhã'.
tokens: núcleo da expressão de tempo, marcada como tópico
modificador de 見物 (forma o composto ロンドン見物)

items.jp: 明日の今ごろはパリにいるはずだ。

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã a esta hora a gente já deve estar em Paris.
translation.en: We should be in Paris by this time tomorrow.

items.label: liga dois substantivos
items.explanation: の junta 明日 e 今ごろ, formando 'por volta desta hora de amanhã'.
tokens: núcleo da expressão de tempo, marcada como tópico
verbo da oração que はず comenta
substantivo que dá o tom de previsão fundamentada
cópula simples que fecha はずだ

items.jp: その本は私のだ

translation.pt-BR: Esse livro é meu.
translation.en: That book is mine.

items.label: nominalizing particle の (準体助詞, 'the one of')
items.explanation: Here の does not link two nouns, but turns 私 into 'mine' (私の = 'the one that is mine'), replacing the noun 本 which is already known.

items.jp: ひどいのに、なんでいい話みたいになってんの？

translation.pt-BR: Sendo uma coisa horrível, por que isso está virando uma história bonitinha?
translation.en: It's a horrible thing, so why is it turning into a cute little story?

items.label: の nominalizer / particle のに (part 1)
items.explanation: Together with the following に it forms 〜のに ('although, despite'); here it nominalizes ひどい to enter that concessive construction.
tokens: adverbializing auxiliary (に of みたいに)

items.jp: これはあっちのより安いよ。

translation.pt-BR: Este aqui é mais barato do que aquele ali, viu.
translation.en: This one is cheaper than that one.

items.label: nominalizing/substitution particle
items.explanation: の here replaces an implied noun: あっちの = 'the (item) over there'. It avoids repeating the thing already known in the conversation.

items.jp: 大きな家はすむのに高くつく。

translation.pt-BR: Casas grandes saem caro para morar.
translation.en: Large houses are expensive to live in.

items.label: nominalizer
items.explanation: The の準体助詞 turns the verb すむ ('to live') into a noun, so that it can receive the particle に.

items.jp: 試験などなければいいのになあ。

translation.pt-BR: Ah, se não existissem provas...
translation.en: I wish there were no examination.

items.label: nominalizing particle (準体助詞)
items.explanation: の nominalizes the preceding clause, preparing it for the に of のに ('although / but').
tokens: adjective of negative existence (in the conditional)

items.jp: 風が強いのはビル風のせいです。

translation.pt-BR: O vento estar forte é por causa do efeito de túnel entre os prédios.
translation.en: The wind being strong is because of the tunnel effect between the buildings.

items.label: nominalizing particle
items.explanation: の turns 風が強い into a noun ('the fact that the wind is strong') to become the topic.

items.jp: 雨がやめばいいのにな。

translation.pt-BR: Quem dera parasse de chover.
translation.en: If only it would stop raining!

items.label: nominalizer
items.explanation: の nominaliza いい e prepara のに junto com o に seguinte.

items.jp: あなたが駅に着くのにどのくらいかかりますか。

translation.pt-BR: Quanto tempo você leva para chegar à estação?
translation.en: How long does it take to get to the station?

items.label: nominalizer
items.explanation: This 「の」 turns 「駅に着く」 into a noun ('the arriving at the station'), so it can take the purpose に.

items.jp: 私の言う事を聞くべきだったのに。

translation.pt-BR: Você devia ter me escutado.
translation.en: You should have listened to me.

items.label: nominalizer
items.explanation: This 「の」 turns the clause 「聞くべきだった」 into something nominal, preparing it to take に and the tone of regret.
tokens: verb of the relative clause (modifies 事)

items.jp: 今のはノーカンだからね。

translation.pt-BR: É porque o que aconteceu agora não conta, viu.
translation.en: It's OK, that doesn't count.

items.label: nominalizing particle ('the one that ~')
items.explanation: の turns 今 ('now') into a noun 'the one from now / what (happened) just now', creating something that can be referred to as a topic.

items.jp: お金がないので、プチッと旅行。

translation.pt-BR: Como eu não tenho dinheiro, vai ser só uma viagenzinha.
translation.en: As I don't have the money, it'll just be a short trip.

items.label: nominalizador que forma ので
items.explanation: Este の empacota お金がない como um bloco para que ので possa apresentar isso como motivo.

items.jp: 母が病気だったので私はそこへ行けなかった。

translation.pt-BR: Como minha mãe estava doente, eu não pude ir lá.
translation.en: Because my mother was ill, I could not go there.

items.label: nominalizador que forma ので
items.explanation: Este の empacota 母が病気だった como um bloco nominal e, junto com で, produz ので ('como', 'porque').

items.jp: 母が病気だったので、私はコンサートに行けなかった。

translation.pt-BR: Como minha mãe estava doente, eu não pude ir ao show.
translation.en: My mother being ill, I couldn't go to the concert.

items.label: nominalizador que forma ので
items.explanation: Este の transforma 母が病気だった em um bloco nominal e, com で, resulta em ので, a conjunção de causa.

items.jp: 別のをいただけますか。

translation.pt-BR: Poderia me trazer outro, por favor?
translation.en: Would you bring me another one, please?

items.label: particle の (nominalizer/pronoun 'the one of')
items.explanation: Here の turns 別 ('different') into a pronoun: 別の = 'a different one / another'. It replaces the omitted noun (the object one wants to swap).

items.jp: 風もないのにドアはひとりでに開いた。

translation.pt-BR: Mesmo sem vento, a porta se abriu sozinha.
translation.en: Although there was no wind blowing, the door opened of itself.

items.label: nominalizer
items.explanation: This 「の」 nominalizes 「風もない」 so that 「に」 can form the concessive expression 「のに」.
tokens: topic / subject of the main clause

items.jp: 父が病気だったので、私は家にいなければならなかった。

translation.pt-BR: Como meu pai estava doente, tive que ficar em casa.
translation.en: My father being sick, I had to stay home.

items.label: nominalizador (parte de ので)
items.explanation: Este の empacota 父が病気だった como um bloco nominal e, junto com で, forma ので ('porque'), apresentando o motivo.

items.jp: 病気だったので、私はパーティーに行きませんでした。

translation.pt-BR: Não fui à festa porque estava doente.
translation.en: I didn't go to the party because I was sick.

items.label: nominalizador (parte de ので)
items.explanation: Este の empacota 病気だった como um bloco nominal e, com で, forma ので ('porque'), que apresenta o motivo de não ter ido.

items.jp: 行かなくちゃいけないの？

translation.pt-BR: Eu tenho que ir mesmo?
translation.en: Do I have to go?

items.label: final question particle (explanatory)
items.explanation: の at the end, with rising intonation, makes the question and gives a tone of seeking confirmation/explanation: 'is it really the case that I have to go?'
tokens: auxiliary verb of the obligation construction

items.jp: 電車で行くつもりなの？それとも車？

translation.pt-BR: Você pretende ir de trem? Ou de carro?
translation.en: Are you going by train or by car?

items.label: informal explanatory sentence-final question particle
items.explanation: の (after な) gives the tone of a question that seeks the interlocutor's explanation/intention.
tokens: head of the predicate (intention to go)

items.jp: 何も言うことはないの？

translation.pt-BR: Você não tem nada a dizer?
translation.en: Do you have nothing to say?

items.label: interrogative/explanatory sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の at the end turns the sentence into a question with a nuance of personal interest.

items.jp: 何かすることはないの？

translation.pt-BR: Você não tem nada para fazer?
translation.en: Don't you have anything to do?

items.label: interrogative/explanatory sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の at the end turns the sentence into a question with a nuance of interest or gentle pressing.

items.jp: どうして入って来ないの？

translation.pt-BR: Por que você não entra?
translation.en: Why don't you come in?

items.label: explanatory/interrogative sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の at the end softens the question and asks for an explanation, common in speech ('why won't you come in, I wonder?').

items.jp: 何がそんなにおかしいの？

translation.pt-BR: O que é tão engraçado assim?
translation.en: What's so funny?

items.label: explanatory/curious interrogative sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の at the end turns the sentence into a question with a tone of curiosity/explanation ('what is it that...?'), common in colloquial speech.

items.jp: 「どうして行かないの？」「行きたくないからだよ」

translation.pt-BR: "Por que você não vai?" "Porque eu não quero ir."
translation.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."

items.label: explanatory/interrogative sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の at the end of the question asks for an explanation in a natural and soft way ('why is it that you won't go?').
tokens: verb (auxiliary in the expression どうして)

items.jp: それで何をしようとしているの？

translation.pt-BR: Então, o que você está tentando fazer?
translation.en: And what are we going to do?

items.label: explanatory sentence-final question particle
items.explanation: の at the end softens the question and gives a tone of wanting to understand/clarify; it is common in colloquial speech.
tokens: auxiliary verb (head of としている)

items.jp: ここには今着いたばかりなの？

translation.pt-BR: Você acabou de chegar aqui agora?
translation.en: Did you just get here?

items.label: explanatory/interrogative sentence-final particle
items.explanation: の (here の? with intonation) makes a question with an explanatory, gentle tone, asking for confirmation in colloquial speech.

items.jp: 毎日薬を飲まなくてはならない

translation.pt-BR: Todo dia eu tenho que tomar remédio.
translation.en: I have to take medicine every day.

items.label: theme/contrast particle (は)
items.explanation: は enters なくては to mark the condition 'if it is the case of not taking...', preparing the conclusion ならない. It is the fixed は within the pattern なくてはならない.

items.jp: アフリカには多くの国があります

translation.pt-BR: Na África existem muitos países.
translation.en: There are many countries in Africa.

items.label: topic/contrast particle
items.explanation: は combined with に (には) highlights 'in Africa' as the subject of the sentence, slightly in contrast with other places.

items.jp: 今日はすこしも寒くない

translation.pt-BR: Hoje não está nem um pouco frio.
translation.en: It isn't the least bit cold today.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta 今日 como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: この駅に急行は止まりません

translation.pt-BR: O expresso não para nesta estação.
translation.en: The express doesn't stop at this station.

items.label: topic particle, with a contrastive nuance
items.explanation: は raises 急行 to the theme of the sentence. Here it also suggests contrast: the express (unlike other trains) does not stop here.

items.jp: 高校生はこの試合に出られない

translation.pt-BR: Estudantes do ensino médio não podem participar deste jogo.
translation.en: High school students can't take part in this game.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は presents 高校生 as the theme of the sentence: 'about high schoolers, (this applies)'.

items.jp: それではまた明日

translation.pt-BR: Então, até amanhã.
translation.en: Well then, see you tomorrow.

items.label: topic/contrast particle within the connector それでは
items.explanation: は closes the expression それでは, giving the tone of 'well then'. It is read 'wa'.
tokens: demonstrative pronoun (part of the connective それでは)

items.jp: 日本語は話せるが英語は話せない

translation.pt-BR: Eu falo japonês, mas inglês eu não consigo falar.
translation.en: I speak Japanese, but I can't speak English.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 日本語 as the first subject: 'as for Japanese'. It sets up the contrast with the other language.

items.jp: 日本語は話せるが英語は話せない

translation.pt-BR: Eu falo japonês, mas inglês eu não consigo falar.
translation.en: I speak Japanese, but I can't speak English.

items.label: topic particle (contrast)
items.explanation: は marks 英語 as the second subject, in contrast with 日本語. This second は closes the は…が…は pattern.

items.jp: では、これからご説明します

translation.pt-BR: Bem, vou explicar para vocês a partir de agora.
translation.en: Well then, I'll explain it to you all from here on.

items.label: topic/contrast particle
items.explanation: は combines with で forming では, marking the start of a new block of discourse ("so, now...").
tokens: main verb (する auxiliary of the compound)

items.jp: この本は新しくはない

translation.pt-BR: Este livro não é novo.
translation.en: This book isn't new.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は presents 本 as the topic: 'as for this book'.

items.jp: 薬を飲む時はアルコールを飲まない

translation.pt-BR: Quando você toma remédio, não bebe álcool.
translation.en: When you're taking medicine, don't drink alcohol.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks the situation 薬を飲む時 ('when taking medicine') as the topic/condition being talked about.
tokens: verb of the clause that modifies 時
head noun of the temporal topic

items.jp: この映画はつまらない

translation.pt-BR: Este filme é chato.
translation.en: This movie is boring.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は presents この映画 as the topic ('speaking of this movie...'). In English it becomes the subject 'this movie'.

items.jp: 雨の日は自転車に乗らない

translation.pt-BR: Em dia de chuva eu não ando de bicicleta.
translation.en: On rainy days I don't ride my bike.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 雨の日 as the topic/condition of the sentence: 'as for rainy days...', establishing the context under which the action does not occur.
tokens: target of the verb 乗る (vehicle)

items.jp: 明日早く起きなくてはならない

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã eu tenho que acordar cedo.
translation.en: I have to wake up early tomorrow.

items.label: theme/contrast particle (は)
items.explanation: は forms なくては, marking the condition 'in case one does not wake up...', which leads to the conclusion ならない. It is the fixed は of the pattern なくてはならない.

items.jp: この問題はぜんぜん分からない

translation.pt-BR: Eu não entendo nada desse problema.
translation.en: I don't understand this problem at all.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks この問題 as the topic of the sentence: "as for this problem...". It presents the subject about which the comment is made.

items.jp: コーヒーは飲むがお茶は飲まない

translation.pt-BR: Eu tomo café, mas chá eu não tomo.
translation.en: I drink coffee, but I don't drink tea.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks コーヒー as the first subject: 'as for coffee'. It begins the contrast between the two drinks.

items.jp: コーヒーは飲むがお茶は飲まない

translation.pt-BR: Eu tomo café, mas chá eu não tomo.
translation.en: I drink coffee, but I don't drink tea.

items.label: topic particle (contrast)
items.explanation: は marks お茶 as the second subject, in contrast with コーヒー. This second は completes the は…が…は pattern.

items.jp: とんでもない、私は何もしていません

translation.pt-BR: Imagina, eu não fiz nada.
translation.en: Not at all, I haven't done anything.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta 私 como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: 今日は何も買いませんでした

translation.pt-BR: Hoje eu não comprei nada.
translation.en: I didn't buy anything today.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は introduces 今日 (today) as the theme of the sentence, setting the moment being talked about. It is read 'wa', not 'ha'.

items.jp: 今日は誰も来なかった

translation.pt-BR: Hoje não veio ninguém.
translation.en: Nobody came today.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 今日 (today) as the topic: 'as for today...'.
tokens: interrogative subject (in a fully negative sense)

items.jp: 町には一万人住んでいる

translation.pt-BR: Nessa cidade moram dez mil pessoas.
translation.en: Ten thousand people live in this town.

items.label: topic particle (with slight contrast)
items.explanation: は after に turns the place into a topic: 'as for this city...'. には emphasizes the place and sets it up as the topic of the sentence.

items.jp: この店には特別なメニューがある

translation.pt-BR: Nesta loja tem um cardápio especial.
translation.en: This store has a special menu.

items.label: marks the topic / gives contrast
items.explanation: は is added to に to highlight the shop as the topic of the sentence ("at this shop,..."), often with a slight contrast relative to other shops.

items.jp: あの店は安くはないが おいしい

translation.pt-BR: Aquele restaurante não é barato, mas a comida é gostosa.
translation.en: That restaurant isn't cheap, but the food is delicious.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 店 as the topic of the sentence ('as for that store'); everything that follows is about it.

items.jp: アジアには国がたくさんある

translation.pt-BR: Na Ásia tem muitos países.
translation.en: There are many countries in Asia.

items.label: topic/contrast particle
items.explanation: は after に turns the place into the topic ('as for Asia...'), setting up the statement about what exists there.

items.jp: 今日はそんなに寒くない

translation.pt-BR: Hoje não está tão frio assim.
translation.en: It's not all that cold today.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 今日 (today) as the subject of the sentence: 'as for today...'. Read as 'wa'.

items.jp: これはわたしのかばんじゃない

translation.pt-BR: Esta não é a minha bolsa.
translation.en: This isn't my bag.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks これ as the theme of the sentence: 'about this...', introducing what is going to be talked about.

items.jp: この店は高いことは高いが、味はいい

translation.pt-BR: Esse restaurante até que é caro, mas a comida é boa.
translation.en: This place is expensive, sure, but the food is good.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta この店 como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: この店は高いことは高いが、味はいい

translation.pt-BR: Esse restaurante até que é caro, mas a comida é boa.
translation.en: This place is expensive, sure, but the food is good.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta 高いこと como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: この店は高いことは高いが、味はいい

translation.pt-BR: Esse restaurante até que é caro, mas a comida é boa.
translation.en: This place is expensive, sure, but the food is good.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta 味 como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: 兄は学生で妹は先生だ

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais velho é estudante e minha irmã mais nova é professora.
translation.en: My older brother is a student and my younger sister is a teacher.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 兄 as the topic of the first clause: of him it is said that he is a student.

items.jp: 兄は学生で妹は先生だ

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais velho é estudante e minha irmã mais nova é professora.
translation.en: My older brother is a student and my younger sister is a teacher.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は reintroduces a new topic (妹) for the second clause, creating a parallel contrast with the brother.

items.jp: それでは始めましょう

translation.pt-BR: Então, vamos começar.
translation.en: All right, let's get started.

items.label: topic/contrast particle within the connector それでは
items.explanation: は joins それで to form それでは, reinforcing the sense of 'well then, given that'. That is why it is read 'wa', not 'ha'.
tokens: demonstrative pronoun (part of the connective それでは)

items.jp: かれはやはり来なかった

translation.pt-BR: Como era de se esperar, ele não veio.
translation.en: As expected, he didn't come.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks かれ as the topic of the sentence (the one being talked about), the one who was expected and did not show up.

items.jp: では、いただきます

translation.pt-BR: Então tá, bom apetite.
translation.en: Well then, thank you for the meal.

items.label: は que compõe a fórmula では (transição)
items.explanation: は fecha o で e completa では: marca a virada, antes de começar a comer.

items.jp: 今日はいそがしくて来られません

translation.pt-BR: Hoje estou ocupado, então não consigo ir.
translation.en: I'm busy today, so I can't go.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 今日 ('today') as the topic: 'as for today...'.

items.jp: テストはかんたんじゃなかった

translation.pt-BR: A prova não foi fácil.
translation.en: The test wasn't easy.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks テスト as the topic: 'as for the test'. The comment 'was not easy' applies to it.

items.jp: 明日は雨かもしれない

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã pode ser que chova.
translation.en: It might rain tomorrow.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は apresenta 明日 como o tópico da frase, ou seja, o assunto sobre o qual se faz a afirmação seguinte.

items.jp: 夏は暑いが冬は寒い

translation.pt-BR: No verão faz calor, mas no inverno faz frio.
translation.en: In summer it's hot, but in winter it's cold.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は introduces 夏 as the first subject: 'as for summer'. It sets the stage for the contrast.

items.jp: 夏は暑いが冬は寒い

translation.pt-BR: No verão faz calor, mas no inverno faz frio.
translation.en: In summer it's hot, but in winter it's cold.

items.label: topic particle (contrast)
items.explanation: は marks 冬 as the second subject, in contrast with 夏. This second は completes the は…が…は pattern.

items.jp: その映画はまだ見ていません

translation.pt-BR: Ainda não vi aquele filme.
translation.en: I haven't seen that movie yet.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 映画 (movie) as the theme of the sentence; with その before, it indicates 'that movie' as the subject, becoming the natural object in pt-BR.

items.jp: あの人は先生じゃない

translation.pt-BR: Aquela pessoa não é professor.
translation.en: That person isn't a teacher.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks あの人 as the topic of the sentence, what is being talked about: 'about that person...'. It is the one that receives the comment 'is not a teacher'.

items.jp: きのうは休みじゃなかった

translation.pt-BR: Ontem não foi folga.
translation.en: Yesterday wasn't a day off.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks きのう as the temporal topic: 'as for yesterday'. The comment 'was not a day off' refers to that day.

items.jp: 今日は朝ご飯を食べないで来ました

translation.pt-BR: Hoje eu vim sem tomar café da manhã.
